title: Asian and Japanese stock markets fall pressured by sell-off in US tech and AI stocks
summary: Stock indices in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore, and China fall or open lower due to the negative impact of artificial intelligence and semiconductor stocks in the United States.

title: SK Hynix plunges over 20 percent following declines in AI and memory stocks
summary: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix suffered a sharp drop following the correction in artificial intelligence and memory-related stocks, also affecting Micron and other companies in the sector.

title: Japanese soccer and technology stocks register mixed movements
summary: Several Japanese players participate in European leagues while companies like Disko report record earnings and Japanese stock markets fall.

title: Waste management and energy stocks Fleetpartners and Cleanaway rise without clear reason
summary: Both Australian companies experience stock market gains without an immediate explanation in available news.
